privileged_info_for_vlm: The view must be named V_FLIGHT_ANALYSIS. The output file must be /home/ga/Desktop/long_haul_report.csv. Key flight IDs that should appear in the final report (Duration > 800) include 100 (Date Line crossing), 200, 800, and 900 (Gap Week). Flight 100 (HND to SFO) and Flight 900 (JFK to LHR) are critical test cases for correct timezone normalization.
